gaussian_ordinary_q2_linesearch -- two datasets that made the Gaussian ordinary q2
SD-regression fit throw `AssertionError: isfinite(phi_c) && isfinite(dphi_c)`
(LineSearches HagerZhang) before the line-search guard.

Source: scale-300 R-versus-Julia campaign (gauss_ord, seeds 179 and 244), generated by
`_gord_fixture(; seed = 730000 + seed)` under Julia 1.10.12 (G = 150 groups, m = 10 rows
each). Layout: line 1 is z0 (150 group values), line 2 is z1, then one `y,x` row per
observation; the group label `g<ceil(row / 10)>` is rebuilt by the test. Both datasets fail with the
unguarded optimiser on Linux/x86 (Julia 1.10.12 and 1.12.7) and on macOS/aarch64
(Julia 1.10.12 and 1.12.6). The reference log-likelihoods and coefficients in
`test_gaussian_ordinary_q2_linesearch.jl` are native drmTMB 0.8.1 fits of these files.
Numbers and data only; no drmTMB source is vendored.
